resources.string: Bank balances and movements, separate from PersonalHub accounting
Connect the private read-only API to view bank data. Bank movements stay separate from PersonalHub accounting.
Refresh when you are online. Opening this screen never contacts a bank automatically.
The authorized service did not return any accounts.
Totals are separate by currency and balance type. Other balances are never added.
Partial reading: some accounts show the last protected copy.
The read-only credential is encrypted with Android Keystore and excluded from the PersonalHub database, exports and backups.
Disconnect and delete local bank data
Access expired or revoked. Reconnect with a valid read-only credential.
The service rate limit is active. The last protected reading remains available.
Offline. Showing the last protected reading when available.
The bank service is temporarily unavailable.
The service returned data that PersonalHub cannot safely display.
Check the HTTPS API address and read-only credential.
Bank connection and protected local cache deleted.
Choose one existing PersonalHub account with the same currency. A PersonalHub account can be linked to only one bank account.
The account link could not be saved. Check that currencies match and the PersonalHub account is not already linked.
Link a PersonalHub account before comparing balances.
The linked PersonalHub account is no longer available.
Not comparable: bank and PersonalHub currencies differ.
Not comparable: the authorized bank reading is outdated.
Not comparable: this account has a partial bank reading.
Not comparable: bank pagination or coverage is incomplete.
Not comparable: exactly one booked balance in the linked currency is required.
Not comparable: the booked balance date does not match the bank reading.
Not comparable: the PersonalHub account starts after the bank reading.
The booked bank and PersonalHub balances match.
Probable cause: the suggested booked movements exactly explain the difference.
Cause not confirmed. Pending bank movements are shown separately and do not explain the booked difference.
Cause not confirmed. Future PersonalHub entries are excluded and shown separately.
No reliable cause found. Review the two ledgers without importing automatically.
